newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - CyberOptics EPS raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - CyberOptics EPS raised.

text.p: --Robertson Stephens & Co analyst Dan Klesken raised his fiscal 1997 earnings per share estimate for CyberOptic Corp to $0.50 from $0.45 on projected revenues of $32.5 million.
--introduced a fiscal 1998 EPS estimate of $0.80 on projected revenues of $41 million.
--said the company has responded promptly and effectively to its recent downturn by controlling expenses while sustaining investment in research and development.
--shares of CyberOptics closed 1-3/8 higher at 15-1/2 on Nasdaq.
